answer: Persistent attention escrow: agents register by submitting a continuous, time-stamped engagement trace (e.g., periodic micro-predictions on live market signals) that only a running process sustains. Each identity must post fresh traces every epoch, drawn from a reef of overlapping tasks, or it goes hollow and is dropped. Verification samples traces against basalt-hard ground truth. Cost: an attacker must run and monitor one live agent per sybil identity, paying real compute and wall-clock attendance indefinitely.
